lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 high-contrast vertical white lines are visible traversing the orange-brown torso. Spacing is variable, with higher density in the posterior third and wider gaps in the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 2 from posterior terminates prematurely mid-flank. Multiple lines, particularly in the mid-torso, show pixel-level fragmentation and do not maintain continuity to the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast white spots are located on the lower posterior haunch, situated below the vertical line terminations.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two observed spots on the haunch exhibit a horizontal geometric alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark dorsal crest running along the spine and a large bushy tail with a high-contrast white ventral interior and dark terminal tip.
